text:
diego_seo: Mini-thread: final SEO ops for launch week. Need concise keyword->url map, webinar JSON-LD, internal anchors, and a redirect plan for old promos.

julia_growth: High-level: publish launch post tying into benchmark pillar, promote webinar landing with gated report, route leads into HubSpot SDR queue.

sara_writer: Seed keywords mapped: 
- pillar: llm-inference-benchmarks -> /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026
- launch post: low-latency-llm -> /blog/launch-low-latency-llm
- webinar: llm-serving-benchmarks -> /webinar/llm-serving-benchmarks-2026

diego_seo: Anchor rules: 2 contextual links from each launch post to pillar, 1 link to webinar. Use natural anchors like "LLM inference benchmarks" and "benchmark report".

julia_growth: Redirects: retired campaign pages -> 301 to pillar; query-string variants -> redirect to canonical webinar landing preserving UTMs. Monitor 404s daily for 7 days post-launch.

eng-bot: Note for infra: sample nginx rule to preserve querystring -> `return 301 https://redwood.example.com/benchmarks/llm-inference-2026$request_uri;`

diego_seo: Minimal webinar JSON-LD (use on landing): {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"LLM Serving Benchmarks 2026","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/llm-serving-benchmarks-2026"}}

sara_writer: Owners/times: Sara -> draft copy + KW map by Thu EOD; Diego -> schema + canonical rules by Fri noon; Mike/Eng -> form hidden fields + redirect rules in staging by next Wed.

diego_seo: Pre-publish checklist: meta title <=70 chars, meta desc ~150 chars, OG image, structured data validated, >=2 internal links, canonical tag, sitemap updated. Quick pre-launch review tomorrow 9:30 PT.
